rows.text: Charged $29.98 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold, and apologies for the slow reply — I missed your deadline. I'm also mid-process on an outside-activities disclosure with my employer, so I'm holding off on any on-the-record, by-name quotes until that's settled. Didn't want to leave you hanging either way. If you're working on something else down the line, I'd be glad to talk properly once that's cleared up. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined (for now) a press-quote request from The Larkin Dispatch — their deadline had already passed anyway.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for the invitation, and apologies that this reply is coming after your signing window closed. I appreciated reading the letter. I'm not able to add Halcyon Threshold as a signatory on public letters right now — I have an outside-activities disclosure in progress with my employer and want that resolved before attaching my name to anything press-facing. I'd like to stay in the loop for future efforts once that's settled. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Declined (for now) signing Corvid Institute's open letter on frontier training runs — their deadline had also already passed.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Thanks — good to meet you too. I'm still narrowing down Halcyon Threshold's first concrete project (weighing a few directions), and I also have an internal approval step to clear before I can be the named, accountable applicant on anything. If I land on something concrete and cleared in time, I'll send a short proposal before the 30th. Appreciate you holding the door open either way. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Kept the door open with Emberfall Fund's rapid grants (closes Nov 30) without committing

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, and five hours a week of real analytical help is genuinely useful. Halcyon Threshold is still just me, so I'd rather start with something concrete and bounded than something vague. Idea: a short landscape / gap-analysis. Basically a spreadsheet of what's already being funded, measured, or covered in AI safety and governance right now (orgs, focus areas, funding sources) versus what keeps coming up as \"neglected\" when people actually talk about it. That's the exact question I asked at the meetup, and a clear-eyed map of the gaps would help me decide where a small, serious effort could actually matter. If that's up your alley, I can send you what little I have so far and we can scope it together. If it doesn't excite you, tell me what does — I'd rather match the work to what you want to do. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (meetup volunteer) with a concrete, non-public starter task: a landscape/gap-analysis spreadsheet
